text: I think the main problem is that the rewards are slow while the effort is immediate. You feel tired after a workout today, but the benefits only show up weeks later, so it's easy to give up. Modern routines don't help either — long working hours and cheap fast food make the unhealthy option the easiest one. That's why small, realistic goals tend to work better than dramatic changes.

tips.en: Rewards are slow while the effort is immediate is a compact contrast.
tips.kk: Rewards are slow while the effort is immediate — сыйымды қарама-қайшылық.
tips.ru: Rewards are slow while the effort is immediate — ёмкий контраст.
tips.example: the rewards are slow while the effort is immediate

tips.en: That's why … ends the answer with a solution.
tips.example: That's why small, realistic goals tend to work better

questions.question: Why do many people find it hard to keep healthy habits?

text: Partly, yes. Individuals obviously have to make their own choices, but governments control a lot of the conditions that shape those choices. For example, they can tax sugary drinks, build safe cycle lanes and make sure school meals are nutritious. Personally, I think that kind of gentle guidance is more effective than simply telling people what to do.

tips.en: Partly, yes and but give responsibility to both people and the state.
tips.kk: Partly, yes және but — адамның да, мемлекеттің де жауапкершілігі.
tips.ru: Partly, yes и but — ответственность и человека, и государства.
tips.example: governments control a lot of the conditions that shape those choices

tips.en: A tax, cycle lanes, school meals — concrete measures.
tips.kk: Салық, велосипед жолдары, мектеп тамағы — нақты шаралар.
tips.ru: Налог, велодорожки, школьное питание — конкретные меры.
tips.example: they can tax sugary drinks, build safe cycle lanes

questions.question: Should the government be responsible for people's health?

text: In some ways it's much easier. We know far more about nutrition, there are fitness apps and gyms everywhere, and medical care has improved enormously. But in other ways it's harder, because most of us move much less than our grandparents did. They walked everywhere and did physical work, whereas we sit in cars and offices all day. So we have better knowledge but worse daily habits.

tips.en: A classic pair for a balanced answer.

title.en: In some ways … in other ways
title.ru: In some ways … in other ways

tips.example: But in other ways it's harder

tips.en: Better knowledge but worse daily habits sums it up in one line.
tips.kk: Better knowledge but worse daily habits — бір сөйлемдегі қорытынды.
tips.ru: Better knowledge but worse daily habits — вывод одной фразой.
tips.example: we have better knowledge but worse daily habits

questions.question: Is it easier to be healthy now than it was in the past?

text: The most obvious way is through PE lessons, but I think they need to be more varied, so that children who hate football can still find something they enjoy, like dance or climbing. Schools could also teach basic cooking, because knowing how to make a simple meal is probably the best protection against junk food. And of course, the food in school canteens should set a good example.

tips.en: More varied and the dance example give a concrete suggestion.
tips.kk: More varied және би туралы мысал — нақты ұсыныс.
tips.ru: More varied и пример с танцами — конкретное предложение.
tips.example: so that children who hate football can still find something they enjoy

tips.en: The best protection against gives a convincing justification.
tips.kk: The best protection against — сенімді негіздеме.
tips.ru: The best protection against — убедительное обоснование.
tips.example: the best protection against junk food

questions.question: How can schools encourage children to be healthier?

text: Definitely, and it's in their own interest too. Employees who are exhausted or constantly stressed make more mistakes and take more sick days, so investing in their health pays off. Simple things like flexible hours, a proper lunch break and not expecting people to answer messages late at night can make a huge difference, and they don't cost the company very much.

tips.en: In their own interest is an argument even an employer would accept.
tips.kk: In their own interest — жұмыс берушіге де сенімді дәлел.
tips.ru: In their own interest — довод, убедительный и для работодателя.
tips.example: it's in their own interest too

tips.en: Simple, cheap steps make the answer practical.
tips.kk: Қарапайым, қымбат емес қадамдар — жауап практикалық.
